verdict.rationale: USPTO documents its own Trademark Status and Document Retrieval (TSDR) system, where new trademark applications appear, which covers trademark status lookup. But the evidence never says TSDR is reachable without logging in. Patent progress tracking is explicitly limited to registered users, and Trademark Center docketing likewise sits behind the account wall. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that TSDR status lookup is public and needs no login, public (non-login) patent application status lookup, and hands-on corroboration of a founder looking up a case status from public pages.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages

citations.quote: New applications appear in the Trademark Status and Document Retrieval (TSDR) system documents tab before review by an examining attorney.
Only as a registered user can you electronically view your submission, track the progress of your application, and respond to USPTO correspondence.
